# GraphAgent 1.0.50

## Reasoning organization and replay

- Prepare eligible reasoning after the first completed model step, then on user turns 4, 7, 10 and so on. Proposal and independent fidelity review complete before the next ordinary model send.
- Continue sending accepted organized reasoning on later turns. Appended conversation messages no longer invalidate evidence belonging to an earlier source; edited source evidence still invalidates it.
- Provide exact source offsets to the organizer. Preserve uncertainty, constraints and rejected alternatives; semantic organization may be longer when the complete request still fits the context limit.
- Keep original persisted reasoning intact. Unsigned reasoning is replaced only for a provider/variant/endpoint/adapter/options tuple with both transport and upstream evidence. Signed and opaque reasoning remains protected. Cache state is rebuilt after process restart.
- Treat a verbatim preservation as a no-op and model-produced review as judged evidence.

## Terminal reliability

- Capture worker console output synchronously before dependency initialization and write it to the log file. SDK warnings no longer write over the interactive terminal.
- Explicitly identify trusted system-message assembly in AI SDK calls.

## Dependencies

- AI SDK 6.0.290 and OpenAI-compatible adapter 2.0.78: maintenance updates within the existing major versions.
- OpenTUI core, Solid integration and keymap 0.5.12; Solid 1.9.12 with consistent dependency resolution. The prior local Solid transition patch is already included upstream.

This release replaces 1.0.49. Provider compatibility and actual reasoning replay require verified configuration; a proposal alone is not a successful replacement.
